'''''Shakajlura''''' ({{lit|blessed lizard}}) is an [[extinct]] genus of [[paracrocodylomorph]] known from the [[Middle Triassic|Middle]]–[[Late Triassic]] ([[Ladinian]]–[[Carnian]] ages) [[Chañares Formation]] of Argentina. The genus contains a [[Monotypic taxon|single species]], '''''Shakajlura riojanensis''''', known from a partial skull and fragmentary skeleton.<ref name="Shakajlura" />

== Discovery and naming ==
{{Location map|Argentina
| width = 125px
| float = left
| relief = yes

| caption= ''S. riojanensis'' [[Type locality (biology)|type locality]] in La Rioja Province, Argentina
| pushpin_relief=1

The ''Shakajlura'' fossil material was discovered during fieldwork in the autumns of 2017 and 2018 in the Campo Cordoba Norte locality of the [[Chañares Formation]] ([[Ischigualasto-Villa Unión Basin]]) in [[Talampaya National Park]] in [[La Rioja Province, Argentina|La Rioja Province]] of northwestern Argentina. These rock layers are assigned to the ''[[Tarjadia]]'' [[Assemblage Zone]]. The fossils were [[Fossil preparation|prepared]] at the [[La Plata Museum]] before being [[Accession number (cultural property)|accessioned]] in the vertebrate paleontology collection of the Centro Regional de Investigaciones Científicas y Transferencia Tecnológica, (CRILAR-Pv) as specimen CRILAR-Pv 572. It consists of various disarticulated pieces of the skull and postcranial skeleton.<ref name="Shakajlura" />

[[File:Shakajlura skull.png|thumb|Reconstructed skull]]
In 2026, Ariel F. Cardillo and colleagues [[Species description|described]] ''Shakajlura riojanensis'' as a new genus and species of paracrocodylomorph based on these fossil remains, establishing CRILAR-Pv 572 as the [[holotype]] specimen. The [[Genus|generic name]], ''Shakajlura'', is derived from the [[Cacán|Kakan]] words {{lang|mis|shakaj}} and {{lang|mis|lura}}, meaning {{gloss|blessed}} and {{gloss|lizard}}, respectively. The [[Specific name (zoology)|specific name]], ''riojanensis'', references the Argentine province from which the holotype was collected.<ref name="Shakajlura" />

== Classification ==
To test the affinities and relationships of ''Shakajlura'', Cardillo et al. (2026) included it in an updated version of the phylogenetic matrix of Desojo & Rauhut (2024).<ref name="D&R2024" /> Using [[implied weighting]], ''Shakajlura'' was recovered in an unresolved [[polytomy]] of early-diverging members of the [[pseudosuchia]]n clade [[Paracrocodylomorpha]], outside of the [[Poposauroidea]] and [[Loricata]]. The roughly coeval ''[[Luperosuchus]]'', which is  comparable in size and superficially similar to ''Shakajlura'', was recovered as a [[Basal (phylogenetics)|basal]] loricatan.
